Felix Suleiman
felix.suleiman@example.com | Orlando, FL
Felix Suleiman has 8 years of experience in marketing. Most recently, Marketing
Manager at Thistledown Consumer Goods (2022-2026), where they coordinated email
campaigns reaching 252K subscribers. Before that, Marketing Coordinator at
Cobblestone Partners (2021-2022). Before that, Marketing Intern at Bellwood
Consulting (2018-2021). Education: B.A. Communications, UC San Diego, 2017.
Core skills: SEO basics, Google Analytics, Canva, Content strategy, HubSpot,
Campaign management.
